title: Enhanced hydrogen storage and release capacities when using HKUST-1@activated carbon hybrids obtained by resonant acoustic mixing
material_description: AC | MSC 30 commercial activated carbon (Kansai Coke, Japan), particle size ~100 µm, used as received in powder form; parent carbon of the HKUST-1@AC (HK-AC p) hybrids
source_location: main p.7, Fig. 6a, series AC (red pentagons; nexc wt.% vs pressure, 77 K)
notes: archive: fig6a_AC_nexc_77K.json. Excess isotherm, 10 plotted markers, no desorption branch shown. Digitizer check vs Table S2 (5.8 wt% at 25 bar) passed by interpolation (5.79). The plotted maximum (about 5.96 wt% near 50 bar) is higher than and at a different pressure from the maximum the text gives (5.8 wt% at 25 bar). Characterization (si1 p.9 Table S1, measured on AC itself): A_BET N2 3030 m2/g (stored), A_BET Ar (87 K) 2830 m2/g; BET by Microactive following Rouquerol criteria, P/P0 range not stated; total pore volume 1.76 cm3/g = V_T N2 at p/p0 = 0.97 (V_T Ar 1.61; V_T 2D-NLDFT 1.60); V_micro 0.90, V_meso 0.70, V_umicro 0.86 (w < 0.7 nm), V_smicro 0.04 cm3/g from 2D-NLDFT-HS applied jointly to N2 and H2 isotherms at 77 K (hence pore_volume_method NLDFT, probe gas other = N2+H2); S_2D-NLDFT 2258, S_smicro 146, S_umicro 1563, S_meso 549 m2/g (not stored; S_meso is a mesopore area, not an external area); packing_density 0.24 g/cm3 from printed tapped density 240 kg m-3 (Autotap, 1500 taps, mean of 3); skeletal_density 2.01 g/cm3 from printed 2010 kg m-3 (He pycnometry, AccuPyc II 1340). H2 method (main p.3 sec. 2.4): HPVA II high-pressure manometric equipment with closed-cycle cryogenic refrigerator (Micromeritics); degassed in a vacuum oven at printed 398 K overnight (degas_temperature_c converted; duration not numeric); sample printed "around 1 g" (stored 1000 mg); n_exc from Leachman EOS; free-volume determination, H2 purity not stated. Main p.5 states that "selected" N2, H2 and Ar isotherms were repeated three times with error < 3 %, without naming samples (textural-analysis context), so replicates_reported = false.
basis_evidence: main p.3: "The excess amount of stored hydrogen (nexc) was calculated using the Leachman equation of state ... From nexc, the total hydrogen uptake (ntot) was determined using Eq. 2: ntot = nexc + (1/rho_tap - 1/rho_skel) rho_H2, where nexc is the measured excess hydrogen uptake"; excess and total reported side by side (si1 p.10 Table S2: "Excess H2 uptake (nexc, wt.%), total H2 uptake (ntot, kg m-3)"; Fig. 6a vs Fig. S9)
